blocks.title: Edge computing
blocks.text: Edge computing processes data at the edge of the network, near where the data are produced, instead of only in central data centres. This reduces latency, the delay of sending data back and forth, and allows faster, real-time decisions.

In autonomous vehicles, data from sensors and cameras are processed inside the vehicle, so it can react quickly to road conditions. Edge computing also suits smart cities, healthcare monitoring and industrial automation, which need real-time processing (Top Tip).
